crossrefs.text: Those who repay my good with evil attack me for pursuing the good.
Those who sit at the gate mock me, and I am the song of drunkards.
But my prayer to You, O LORD, is for a time of favor. In Your abundant loving devotion, O God, answer me with Your sure salvation.
For without cause they laid their net for me; without reason they dug a pit for my soul.
But I call to God, and the LORD saves me.
Morning, noon, and night, I cry out in distress, and He hears my voice.
Then Jesus said, “Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing.” And they divided up His garments by casting lots.
To You, O LORD, I call; be not deaf to me, O my Rock. For if You remain silent, I will be like those descending to the Pit.
Whoever turns his ear away from hearing the law, even his prayer is detestable.
Then the angel showed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of the LORD, with Satan standing at his right hand to accuse him.
My anger will be kindled, and I will kill you with the sword; then your wives will become widows and your children will be fatherless.

You shall not bow down to them or worship them; for I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on their children to the third and fourth generations of those who hate Me,
Do not cover up their iniquity or let their sin be blotted out from Your sight, for they have provoked the builders.
But the face of the LORD is against those who do evil, to wipe out all memory of them from the earth.
But You, O God, will bring them down to the Pit of destruction; men of bloodshed and deceit will not live out half their days. But I will trust in You.
The memory of the righteous is a blessing, but the name of the wicked will rot.
The backslider in heart receives the fill of his own ways, but a good man is rewarded for his ways.
For with the same judgment you pronounce, you will be judged; and with the measure you use, it will be measured to you.
Therefore pride is their necklace; a garment of violence covers them.
May this water that brings a curse enter your stomach and cause your belly to swell and your thigh to shrivel.’ Then the woman is to say, ‘Amen, Amen.’
therefore as surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, I will give you over to bloodshed and it will pursue you. Since you did not hate bloodshed, it will pursue you.
Then they said to one another, “Surely we are being punished because of our brother. We saw his anguish when he pleaded with us, but we would not listen. That is why this distress has come upon us.”

When he has made her drink the water, if she has defiled herself and been unfaithful to her husband, then the water that brings a curse will enter her and cause bitter suffering; her belly will swell, her thigh will shrivel, and she will become accursed among her people.

Then David said to Abishai and to all his servants, “Behold, my own son, my own flesh and blood, seeks my life. How much more, then, this Benjamite! Leave him alone and let him curse me, for the LORD has told him so. Perhaps the LORD will see my affliction and repay me with good for the cursing I receive today.”
He seals up the hand of every man, so that all men may know His work.

At the time of the evening sacrifice, Elijah the prophet approached the altar and said, “O LORD, God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, let it be known this day that You are God in Israel and that I am Your servant and have done all these things at Your command.
Answer me, O LORD! Answer me, so that this people will know that You, the LORD, are God, and that You have turned their hearts back again.”
“This is the finger of God,” the magicians said to Pharaoh. But Pharaohʼs heart was hardened, and he would not listen to them, just as the LORD had said.

This day the LORD will deliver you into my hand. This day I will strike you down, cut off your head, and give the carcasses of the Philistine army to the birds of the air and the creatures of the earth. Then the whole world will know that there is a God in Israel.
And all those assembled here will know that it is not by sword or spear that the LORD saves; for the battle is the LORDʼs, and He will give all of you into our hands.”
Arise, O LORD, confront them! Bring them to their knees; deliver me from the wicked by Your sword,

from such men, O LORD, by Your hand— from men of the world whose portion is in this life. May You fill the bellies of Your treasured ones and satisfy their sons, so they leave their abundance to their children.
The LORD is your keeper; the LORD is the shade on your right hand.
I have set the LORD always before me. Because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
Yet I am always with You; You hold my right hand.
The Lord is at Your right hand; He will crush kings in the day of His wrath.
I know that the LORD upholds justice for the poor and defends the cause of the needy.
No weapon formed against you shall prosper, and you will refute every tongue that accuses you. This is the heritage of the servants of the LORD, and their vindication is from Me,” declares the LORD.
Hallelujah! I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart in the council of the upright and in the assembly.
Do not rob a poor man because he is poor, and do not crush the afflicted at the gate,
